name: e9c05267-history-bar-mount
description: Ошибка e9c05267: полоса истории обязана рисоваться по кэшу, не дожидаясь thoughts/resolve, и дедуплицировать resolve в полёте. Метрика детерминирована: ведётся ПОКОЛЕНИЕ элемента .history-bar (пересборка workspace = новый хост) и меряется окно пустоты НОВОГО хоста, а не старой полосы. Прогон: ui-probe-stand --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.e9c05267-history-bar-mount.scenario.json --delay-seed-response-rule 2500:thoughts/resolve --delay-seed-response-rule 800:thoughts/query. Красная фаза (до фикса a1a9899d, тот же сценарий): пустота нового хоста 2551 мс, контент на +2618 мс; после фикса — 66 мс / +136 мс.

steps.name: open-network-a
steps.probe: (() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.network-item')]; const item = items.find((e) => (e.textContent || '').includes('{{networkName}}')) ?? items[0]; if (item === undefined) return 'no-item'; item.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: install-poller
steps.eval: (() => { window.__hb = { samples: [], iv: 0, mark: 0, gen: 0, last: null, genAtMark: 0 }; window.__hb.iv = setInterval(() => { const h = document.querySelector('.history-bar'); if (h !== window.__hb.last) { window.__hb.last = h; window.__hb.gen += 1; } window.__hb.samples.push({ t: Date.now(), gen: window.__hb.gen, exists: h !== null, n: h === null ? -1 : h.children.length, chips: h === null ? -1 : h.querySelectorAll('.history-cloud').length, empty: h === null ? -1 : h.querySelectorAll('.history-empty').length, text: h === null ? '' : (h.textContent || '').slice(0, 40), w: h === null ? -1 : h.clientWidth }); if (window.__hb.samples.length > 1200) window.__hb.samples.shift(); }, 40); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: before-switch
steps.probe: (async () => { const p = (await window.etn.server.listProfiles()).find((x) => x.isActive); const tabs = await window.etn.tabs.list(); const t = tabs.find((x) => x.network_id === '{{networkId}}'); const rows = (await window.etn.history.list(p.id, '{{networkId}}', t.tab_id, 50)).map((e) => e.thoughtId.slice(0, 8)); const h = document.querySelector('.history-bar'); return JSON.stringify({ focus: (t.focus_id || '').slice(0, 8), rows, bar: { children: h.children.length, chips: h.querySelectorAll('.history-cloud').length, empty: h.querySelectorAll('.history-empty').length, text: (h.textContent || '').slice(0, 30) } }); })()

steps.name: create-network-b
steps.probe: (async () => { const n = await window.etn.networks.create('Сеть B e9c05267'); window.__netB = n.id; return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-picker
steps.eval: (() => { const plus = document.querySelector('.tab-plus'); if (plus === null) return 'no-plus'; plus.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-network-b-tab
steps.probe: (() => { const item = [...document.querySelectorAll('.network-item')].find((e) => (e.textContent || '').includes('Сеть B e9c05267')); if (item === undefined) return 'no-item'; item.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: bar-in-b
steps.eval: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('.history-bar'); return JSON.stringify({ children: h.children.length, chips: h.querySelectorAll('.history-cloud').length, empty: h.querySelectorAll('.history-empty').length, text: (h.textContent || '').slice(0, 30) }); })()

steps.name: back-to-tab-a
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('{{networkName}}')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: return-timeline
return-blank-gate
steps.probe: (() => { const mark = window.__hb.mark; const genAtMark = window.__hb.genAtMark; const S = window.__hb.samples.filter((x) => x.t >= mark); const fresh = S.filter((x) => x.gen !== genAtMark && x.n >= 0); const hostAt = fresh.length > 0 ? fresh[0] : null; const newGen = hostAt === null ? 0 : hostAt.gen; const inNew = S.filter((x) => x.gen === newGen); const content = inNew.find((x) => x.n > 0); const problems = []; if (hostAt === null) problems.push('no-new-host'); if (content === undefined) problems.push('no-content'); if (hostAt !== null && content !== undefined && content.t - hostAt.t > 1000) problems.push('blank=' + (content.t - hostAt.t)); return problems.length === 0 ? 'ok' : problems.join('; '); })()

steps.name: final-state
steps.probe: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('.history-bar'); return ({ children: h.children.length, chips: h.querySelectorAll('.history-cloud').length, empty: h.querySelectorAll('.history-empty').length, text: (h.textContent || '').slice(0, 40), width: h.clientWidth }); })()

steps.name: final-bar-gate
steps.probe: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('.history-bar'); const chips = h.querySelectorAll('.history-cloud').length; const empty = h.querySelectorAll('.history-empty').length; const text = (h.textContent || '').trim(); const problems = []; if (h.children.length === 0) problems.push('bar-empty'); if (chips === 0 && empty === 0) problems.push('no-content'); if (text === '') problems.push('no-text'); return problems.length === 0 ? 'ok' : problems.join('; '); })()
